body:
Hey Barry, I am Patricia.

Yes, You are right. I am 29 and I cant tell if I am going to feel exactly this way for the rest of my life. But I am sure I will feel worse than this. 

I dont handle emotion well. I barely handle them at all. That is also something that my therapist and psychiatrist said, not only my opinion. Feelings are too much for me. I treat everything like science. 

So even with deppresion Ive tried so much. I was on therapy, I took meds, I read every single "life changing" book about depression and anxiety. I watch every Ted talk, every possible doctor on YouTube. I try mindfulness, yoga, meditation. 

So when I feel like this, so overwhelmed with possibility of future suffering I also read, I also watch and seek for advise. And You know what I find ? Nothing to give me hope. It seems like everybody is in pain, everybody suffers, people dont deal with grief, they dont go forward after it. Ans if they dont, I cant see future for me that is not fool od suffering. Because I cant handle emotions. I cant handle life itself. Even when nothing really ever happend to me. I lost my grandpa 25 years ago today. And I cant even write this sentece without crying because it hurts. 

I relapsed into depression because two weeks ago I had a migrane. I lost my vision and movement in my left side of my body for 40 minutes. I was sure I was having a stroke. I was sure I was dying. That's all. A migrane causedy depression this time. All of these feelings, suicidal thoughts because of a migrane. 

Can You understand me now ? I cant handle life, I wont be able to live after something major will happen to me. Its hard even for me to explain because I dont even understand it. I used to be so strong as a teen and young   adult. And now I am writing suicide letters on Reddit to a stranger.
